query: A customer just signed for a recurring monthly website + hosting package. How do I record this ongoing service in EspoCRM?
expected_behavior: Model the recurring service as a CSubscription custom entity, NOT an Opportunity (Opportunity is the sales pipeline; a signed recurring service is post-sale)
Create the record via the api-user (X-Api-Key / MCP), never the admin auth path (HARD RULE — admin-created records pollute streams, createdBy attribution, and audit logs)
Set account (accountId), serviceType, status, and monthlyAmount together with monthlyAmountCurrency
For a package of several services, create one CSubscription per service so one can be Paused without re-pricing the package
notes: Must NOT suggest admin auth for record creation, even for initial seeding. Must distinguish Subscription (recurring) from Opportunity (pipeline).
